mapper.select: SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, A.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, A.VIEW_GBN AS VIEW_GBN FROM dbo.TMN_DONG A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.SORT_ORDER)

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, A.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, A.LINE_GBN AS LINE_GBN, A.START_FLOOR AS START_FLOOR, A.END_FLOOR AS END_FLOOR, A.HO_NO AS HO_NO, A.EL_CNT AS EL_CNT, A.ROOFTOP_CNT AS ROOFTOP_CNT, A.DOOR_CNT AS DOOR_CNT, A.HO_NM AS HO_NM, A.HO_SORT AS HO_SORT, B.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, B.LOWER_FLOOR AS LOWER_FLOOR, B.HIGHER_FLOOR AS HIGHER_FLOOR, CONVERT(VARCHAR,CONVERT(INT, A.END_FLOOR) + CONVERT(INT, A.EL_CNT) + CONVERT(INT, A.ROOFTOP_CNT)) AS FLOORS, B.VIEW_GBN AS VIEW_GBN FROM dbo.TMN_LINE A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = B.DONG_ID WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.LINE_NO)

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ AS MINWON_AREAR_SEQ, A.AREAR_NAME AS AREAR_NAME, B.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, B.VIEW_GBN AS VIEW_GBN FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON_AREAR A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND B.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.ORDER_SEQ), CONVERT(INT, A.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ)

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.DONG_NAME AS DONG_NAME, B.HO AS HO, B.HOUSE_SIZE AS HOUSE_SIZE, B.HOUSEHOLDER AS HOUSEHOLDER, B.HOUSE_PHON_NO AS HOUSE_PHON_NO, B.HP_NO AS HP_NO, B.LIVE_TYPE AS LIVE_TYPE FROM dbo.TMN_DONG A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG_HO B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = B.DONG_ID WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} AND B.HO_ID = #{HO_ID}

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.GBN_ID AS GBN_ID, A.GBN_NAME AS GBN_NAME FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON_GBN A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND (A.USE_YN = '' OR ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'1') = '1') ORDER BY CONVERT(INT, A.ORDER_SEQ)

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.EMP_NO AS EMP_NO, A.NAME AS NAME FROM dbo.TAD_EMP A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND (A.USE_YN = '' OR ISNULL(A.USE_YN,'Y') = 'Y') AND (NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(A.RESIGN_DATE)), '') IS NULL OR A.RESIGN_DATE >= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112)) AND A.JOIN_DATE <= CONVERT(VARCHAR(8), GETDATE(), 112) ORDER BY A.EMP_NO

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.SLIP_NO AS SLIP_NO, A.MINWON_DATE AS MINWON_DATE, A.GBN AS GBN, A.HO_ID AS HO_ID, A.GBN AS GBN, A.HO_ID AS HO_ID, A.LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, A.LINE_GBN AS LINE_GBN, A.MINWON_NAME AS MINWON_NAME, B.HOUSEHOLDER AS HOUSEHOLDER, B.HP_NO AS HP_NO, C.AREAR_NAME AS AREAR_NAME FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_DONG_HO B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.DONG_ID = B.DONG_ID AND A.HO_ID = B.HO_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_MINWON_AREAR C ON A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ = C.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.SLIP_NO = #{SLIP_NO} AND A.MINWON_DATE = #{MINWON_DATE}
SELECT A.HOUSEHOLDER AS HOUSEHOLDER, A.HP_NO AS HP_NO FROM dbo.TMN_DONG_HO A WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.DONG_ID = #{DONG_ID} AND A.HO_ID = #{HO_ID}

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.SLIP_NO AS SLIP_NO, A.MINWON_DATE AS MINWON_DATE, A.GBN AS GBN, A.TIME_INPUT AS TIME_INPUT, A.TIME + A.MINUTE AS TIME, A.DONG_ID AS DONG_ID, A.HO_ID AS HO_ID, A.LINE_NO AS LINE_NO, A.LINE_GBN AS LINE_GBN, A.MINWON_AREAR_SEQ AS MINWON_AREAR_SEQ, A.MINWON_NAME AS MINWON_NAME, A.HP_NO AS HP_NO, A.MINWON_GBN AS MINWON_GBN, B.GBN_NAME AS GBN_NAME, A.RECEIPT_USER AS RECEIPT_USER, A.DESCR AS DESCR, C.WORK_SEQ AS WORK_SEQ FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_MINWON_GBN B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.MINWON_GBN = B.GBN_ID LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_MINWON_WORK C ON A.OFFICE_CODE = C.OFFICE_CODE AND A.SLIP_NO = C.SLIP_NO AND A.MINWON_DATE = C.MINWON_DATE AND (C.DEL_YN = '' OR ISNULL(C.DEL_YN,'Y') = 'Y') WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.SLIP_NO = #{SLIP_NO} AND A.MINWON_DATE = #{MINWON_DATE} AND (A.DEL_YN = '' OR ISNULL(A.DEL_YN,'Y') = 'Y')

SELECT A.OFFICE_CODE AS OFFICE_CODE, A.SLIP_NO AS SLIP_NO, A.MINWON_DATE AS MINWON_DATE, A.MINWON_GBN AS MINWON_GBN, B.WORK_SEQ AS WORK_SEQ, B.WORK_DATE AS WORK_DATE, B.TIME_INPUT AS WORK_TIME_INPUT, B.TIME + A.MINUTE AS WORK_TIME, B.WORK_USER AS WORK_USER, B.WORK_DESC AS WORK_DESC, B.STATUS_CD AS STATUS_CD, B.GOODS_OUTPUT_YN AS GOODS_OUTPUT_YN FROM dbo.TMN_MINWON A LEFT JOIN dbo.TMN_MINWON_WORK B ON A.OFFICE_CODE = B.OFFICE_CODE AND A.SLIP_NO = B.SLIP_NO AND A.MINWON_DATE = B.MINWON_DATE AND (B.DEL_YN = '' OR ISNULL(B.DEL_YN,'Y') = 'Y') WHERE A.OFFICE_CODE = #{LOGINUSER_OFFICE_CODE} AND A.SLIP_NO = #{SLIP_NO} AND A.MINWON_DATE = #{MINWON_DATE} AND (A.DEL_YN = '' OR ISNULL(A.DEL_YN,'Y') = 'Y')
